mlutils.modeling

Public entry point for PyTorch modeling symbols in mlutils.

When PyTorch is available, this module re-exports NNmodel, AutoEncoderModel, torchModel, and instantiate_models from mlutils.modeling_torch. Otherwise those names are None and instantiate_models raises ImportError.
